encoding.csv: UTF-8 with BOM, comma delimiter, LF newlines, RFC4180 quoting
encoding.lists_in_csv: JSON array string; no semicolon-separated ad-hoc lists
encoding.dates: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD with explicit date_precision; capture timestamps RFC3339 UTC

paper_identity: Preserve accepted cvf:EDITION:SLUG. DOI/OpenAlex/arXiv become aliases; never silently rewrite IDs.
author_identity: Separate authorship appearances from verified Author identity. Never merge or create global people solely by name.

relations.condition: Verified ordered authorship of representative paper.
Paper-specific verified affiliation. Keep supporting paper IDs and years in evidence.
Source paper cites target paper in references. Never derive from citation_count.
Country of institution, not nationality of researcher.
Distinct verified authors on the same representative core paper.
Two distinct authors attached to the two distinct institutions on the same core paper.
Current work studies the task; sentence/title evidence required.
Current method uses/builds method; exclude related work and baseline-only mentions.
Current work evaluated on dataset; pretraining or a name mention alone is insufficient.

edge_id_rule: edge: + SHA256(src + U+0000 + type + U+0000 + dst). For undirected edges sort endpoints lexicographically first.
edge_weights: COAUTHORED_WITH/COLLABORATED_WITH = number of distinct representative core papers; other types = 1; aggregate evidence IDs and paper IDs.
evidence_offsets: Zero-based Unicode code-point offsets [start_char,end_char) in normalized title/abstract identified by source_record_id + field_path. Null for metadata JSON paths.
derived_evidence: point supporting_evidence_ids to actual source evidence, retain paper IDs and distinct author pair where required.
neo4j: Unpack json_array CSV cells into native string arrays; nested JSON objects are not Neo4j properties.

authorships.csv.null_key_policy: For unresolved appearances, one blank institution_id per authorship_id. Replace this missing row when verified affiliations arrive. This is a CSV logical key, not a SQL primary key.

evidence_id_rule: Use src.common.evidence_id: SHA256 with U+0000-separated paper_id, source_record_id, field_path, rule_id, rule_version, evidence_text or empty, start_char or empty, end_char or empty, compact JSON of sorted distinct supporting_evidence_ids; prefix evidence:.
